engine.induction_and_feed: Naturally aspirated, crankcase-scavenged, muffler-pressure fuel feed

mass.basis: O.S. archive lists 404 g engine and 120 g E-3070; AIAA lists 404 g bare and 525 g muffled test article; O.S. 2006 launch page reports 542 g for earlier configuration.
mass.status: identify actual silencer/revision and weigh before accepting installed mass

configuration.silencer: stock O.S. silencer; exact E-307x revision to verify on hardware

fuel.manual_conflict: MAX-55AX manual fuel paragraph names MAX-46AXII; do not treat its percentages as resolved 55AX-specific limits.
fuel.field_test_fuel: O.S. NITRO-X Standard Red (15-18), without weighed fuel-flow data
fuel.status: candidate blend differs from O.S. field-test fuel and manual applicability is unresolved

manufacturer_compatible_propellers.observed_data_limit: one field configuration; no torque/thrust/flow curve
manufacturer-compatible size only; no matched engine/prop test located

torque_power.candidate_curve: generated by calibration_report.py from current candidate profile
torque_power.independent_measurement: AIAA 2016-5011 reports limited MAX-55AX hybrid-system part-load data; no full WOT curve imported
torque_power.uncertainty_status: candidate sensitivity is not a confidence interval

throttle_response.status: family-prior sensitivity only; no MAX-55AX step fit
throttle_response.integrated_lifecycle: GlowLifecycle models servo, air-admission and fuel-transport states; installed time constants are inferred and unvalidated for MAX-55AX

combustion_dynamics.status: mean-cycle profile plus lifecycle event/phase accumulator and assumed smooth mixture/temperature firing fraction; engine-specific misfire boundary and cycle variation unmeasured

propeller_compatibility.paired_static_advancing_scenarios: calibration_report.json: full-admission roots at 0, 10, 20 and 30 m/s with nonstatistical assumption envelopes
propeller_compatibility.recommended_experimental_installed_defau: APC Sport LP12070 12x7; the only MAX-55AX/prop RPM observation found

conditional_12x7_single_rpm_fit.reference_density_basis: candidate profile density; O.S. reports 3 C but no barometric pressure
conditional_12x7_single_rpm_fit.status: one-point fit using estimated blade-element sections; zero residual by construction, not independent validation

pitch_speed_example_mph.meaning: geometric pitch speed only, not airspeed or thrust

fuel_consumption.aiaa_2t_flow_fit: 0.46*x + 28.60 mg/s; R2=0.96; x is ESC demand in watts
fuel_consumption.evidence_scope: MAX-55AX in hybrid setup, one-minute steady samples, not shaft-power or flight-flow fit
fuel_consumption.candidate_curve: per-knot inferred delivered/burned/unburned flow in calibration_report.json

idle_stalling.status: lifecycle implements start/stop, minimum-start and inferred firing/stall thresholds; no repeated MAX-55AX warm hold, stall boundary or mixture repeatability data

temperature_cooling.status: integrated scalar thermal energy model is a software candidate; sensor/model search only, not MAX-55AX temperature, target or failure threshold

sound_vibration.status: orders are kinematic; engine-specific tach-synchronized recording absent

aircraft_dynamics.status: no takeoff, climb, cruise, acceleration, engine-out or windmilling validation

configuration_provenance.runtime_status: transient/lifecycle and thermal plumbing implemented; installation constants and engine behavior remain inferred, not physically validated

external_cross_checks.relevant_published_prop_or_flow: 13x7-8 or 14x5-6; about 35 cm3/min at 10000 rpm, load-dependent
external_cross_checks.use: different larger 4T architecture; no MAX-55AX parameter transfer

external_cross_checks.relevant_difference: boosted charge and model-specific pressure/injection or pump fuel systems
external_cross_checks.use: architecture distinction only; no naturally aspirated 2T transfer
same broad family comparator only; no MAX-55AX curve transfer

required_missing_data: matched 8-point shaft torque/RPM sweep and five-position throttle/mixture data
matched APC 12x7 and APC 13x6 propeller load/thrust/torque/inertia data
servo-separated rise/fall commands, barrel angle, RPM and repeated idle/stall outcomes
weighed fuel flow and endurance, installed thermal/cooling records
tach-synchronized sound/vibration, full aircraft telemetry and named experienced-pilot review
